summary: Tapah is a large native Southeast Asian catfish. Its accepted scientific name is Wallagonia leerii; the older forms Wallago leerii and Wallago leeri still occur in fisheries literature.
nativeRange: The Malay Peninsula, Sumatra and Borneo, with mainland Southeast Asian records.

habitat.description: Freshwater river systems; historical records include Kenyir, although recent confirmation of its population there is needed.
